title: Attachment too large to send
symptom: Email will not send because the attachment is too large
user_description: I'm trying to email a big presentation to a client and it keeps bouncing. How can I get it to them?

options.text: Send it from a personal email account instead
options.why: Moves company data outside approved systems and is a security and policy risk.

options.text: Raise the size limit for the whole company
options.why: A huge change that affects the whole system to solve one user's problem. Not a first step.

options.text: Share the file as a link using the company's approved cloud storage instead of attaching it
options.why: Links avoid mail size limits, and approved storage keeps company files secure and lets you control who can open them.

options.text: Split it into many small emails
options.why: Clumsy and unprofessional. The client gets many messages and may never put the file together.

hints: Does the file have to travel inside the email itself?
Where does the company want files like this to be stored and shared?
real_world_tip: Check the link permissions. Set it to specific people or view-only so the file does not end up shared with everyone.
